Meaningful minds

Support and management staff

  • Directly to
    • All vacancies for support and management staff

Working in management or support

A better future through science? Join the Eindhoven University of Technology and contribute to a brighter tomorrow for us all. You understand what researchers and students care about and how they operate. That way, you can deliver high-quality support that helps them achieve their goals. As a professional you have a hunger for knowledge in your field of expertise and do not shy away from being a true partner. Find vacancies for management and support staff here - and join TU/e!

  • Support and management staff vacancies

  • Application Process

    We are delighted that you are considering to apply for a job at TU/e. We embrace diversity and inclusion, and invite people from all backgrounds to apply for a job at TU/e. Here's what the application process looks like.

    Read more

  • Conditions of Employment

    A job at TU/e falls under the collective agreement (CAO) for Dutch Universities. In addition, there are staff regulations and codes of conduct that apply specifically to TU/e employees.

    Read more

  • Learning & Development

    You will have free access to high-quality training programs, tailored to specific groups and situations. As a result, you will be able to deepen or broaden your expertise. We support you in designing your career as you see fit.

    Read more

  • Why join TU/e?

    Join the Eindhoven University of Technology and its thriving community of scientists, students, and professionals. Shape your own career as you become part of a personal university with a big impact. A university where managers and support staff members are valued as true partners in achieving the best results while working on a vibrant and inspiring campus.

    • Why TU/e?

Watch our videos: Working at TU/e

Discover how you can contribute to a better world as an employee at TU/e. How does our support and management staff experience their work? Why did they choose to join us and what makes them proud to work for TU/e?

Library and Information Services

As an IT consultant at the TU/e, you cannot fall back on standard solutions. The research is always in motion, which makes the work particularly dynamic. There is always a direction in which you can develop!

Finance and Control

In this beautiful, international workplace, you can see all sorts of things happening around you. The open, informal work atmosphere offers a lot of freedom to do your job. No day is ever the same!
